meta.description: Reaches Home Assistant from anywhere, the Companion app included, through a Cloudflare Tunnel: no port is opened on the router, Home Assistant's own login with two-factor is the gate, and Cloudflare blocks every country outside the list the household gives. Needs a Cloudflare account with a domain.

explain.title: About remote access
explain.description: Remote access supports access from outside; installed metadata does not establish tunnel health.
